messages:
Leah (AE): FYI, DeltaRetail POC hit a 5xx storm during investor demo. They ramped from 50 -> 600rps over ~75s. Need quick actions + a checklist for future demos. @Max (oncall) @Nina (support)
Max (oncall): saw spike. Gateway returned 503s with header x-rw-throttle: capacity_throttle. Autoscaler started but pods became Ready too slowly (~20s). Queue grew and we hit configured queue_ms cutoff which triggers 503s.
Nina (support): customer curl: 
curl -i https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT'
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
x-rw-throttle: capacity_throttle
retry-after: 1.0
{ "error": "server overloaded" }

Raj (solutions): they asked if a Dedicated demo slot or temporary reserved capacity is possible and cost estimate. Also asked about graceful degradation options.
Max (oncall): immediate mitigations we applied: increased per-pod max_inflight, enabled fallback to rwd-medium-v1, triggered manual warm-up of 5 pods. Errors fell within ~90s.
Nina (support): logs (sanitized): [2026-07-12T16:02:10Z] req=dr-01 status=503 reason=capacity_throttle q_ms=4100
[2026-07-12T16:02:22Z] autoscaler desired=10 current=2 provisioning=8 pod_ready_s=20
[2026-07-12T16:02:25Z] burstpool_remaining=0

Max (oncall): recommendations checklist for demos:
- Pre-warm: synthetic 60s load at 25-30% expected RPS, start 10-20m before demo
- Burstpool: enable for demo window via sales ops (consumption billed)
- Client retry: exponential backoff with jitter, base ~200-300ms, cap retries at 3
- Early fallback: header x-rw-fallback to rwd-medium-v1 after first 503
- Monitor: watch queue_ms and burstpool_remaining in console during demo
- For sustained >400rps: request Dedicated/demo slot (SRE provisioning)

Raj (solutions): pricing note: short reserved/demo slots are supported; I'll send hourly estimate. Also proposing a "demo profile" model with reduced context to lower per-request resources.
infra-bot: manual-scale: added 5 warm pods to cluster-dr-poc (id cl-dr-021)
Leah (AE): shared checklist with customer and scheduled a rehearse. Also flagged security questions separately.
Max (oncall): follow-ups: ENG-PLATFORM ticket for faster warm-starts and a prewarm API for POCs. If customer tolerates higher tail latency we can raise queue_ms threshold per-account.
Nina (support): closing note: errors subsided after mitigations; customer will rerun demo next week. Action items assigned to Raj (pricing), ENG-PLATFORM (warm-start), and Solutions/legal for security.
